title: MusicRow
description: Schema for a single row in music.csv. All rows carry claim_class=listed-only. No field grants tools, memory, autonomy, medical protocol, or network access. The database annotates GFI dimension signals in existing works — it does not assert that music causes any effect.

id.description: Lowercase hyphenated canonical identifier. Must be unique across the catalog.

artist.description: Primary artist or composer. For traditional works, use 'Traditional' with arranger noted.

year.description: Year of original composition or earliest known recording.

key.description: Root note of the primary key (e.g. C, F#, Bb). Use standard pitch-class notation.

mode.description: Modal quality of the primary key.

bpm.description: Approximate tempo in beats per minute. Use the dominant section tempo.

gfi_primary.description: Dominant GFI dimension signal carried by this work's lyric and sonic field.

semantic_summary.description: Researcher-authored analysis of the work's GFI signal. Must not reproduce lyric text beyond 8-word identification phrases. Must not assert the work causes any physical, psychological, or metaphysical effect.

source_url.description: Reference URL (Genius, Wikipedia, CC license page, etc.). The database cites, does not host.

license.description: Copyright status of the original work.

claim_class.description: Always listed-only. Any other value is a schema violation.
